feature_summary: This epic implements the Items Management feature for Repair Orders (Service module). It delivers a unified screen for service technicians and parts staff to manage all stock items, non-inventory items, digital products, and customer-provided items across one or more Jobs within a Repair Order. The main technical changes involve: (1) new and modified endpoints in tps-dms-repair-order for stock item CRUD, commit/uncommit, deliver, bulk actions, move, edit, delete, replace, and special order creation; (2) synchronous calls from RepairOrder service to PartsMerchandiseInventory for all quantity-affecting operations; (3) event publishing (RepairSpecialOrderCreated) when insufficient-QOH paths trigger special order creation. Primary services: Tps.Dms.RepairOrder and Tps.Dms.PartsMerchandiseInventory.

business_rules: BR-3: Commit/uncommit formula follows Story 07 exactly; 422 on invalid transition
BR-4: If commit delta > QOH in Story 07, return Trigger #6
BR-5: DeliveredTo required for deliver flows; 400 if missing
BR-6: Bulk operations process per-line; skip invalid; return partial success
BR-7: Delete rollback preserves non-negative inventory; 422 on invalid state
BR-8: All quantity-affecting commands synchronous and atomic; no partial RO writes
BR-9: If RO persistence fails after inventory success, compensating rollback mandatory; 502 if compensation fails
architectural_patterns: Sync-first write: validate → inventory sync → RO persist
Compensating transaction on RO persist failure
Refit Common Policy for resilience (5s timeout, exponential backoff, circuit breaker)
Trigger mapping adapter for BRD trigger semantics

nfrs.concurrency: OCC (ROWVERSION) on all quantity-affecting writes; 409 on mismatch
nfrs.resilience: Refit common policy: exponential backoff, circuit breaker, 5s per inventory call
nfrs.compensation: Compensating inventory rollback mandatory if RO persist fails; 502 on compensation failure
nfrs.security: Entra External ID JWT, [Authorize] on all endpoints, tenant+org isolation filters mandatory

frd.title: FRD: Service – Repair Order Stock Item Management
functional_requirements: FR-01: Items Management Screen — Items tab in RO; jobs in ascending Job ID; items grouped; empty state; Add Item; per-item actions: Commit, Deliver, Delete, Alternate Item, Create SO; Bulk Commit and Bulk Deliver
FR-02: Item Types — Stock (full commit/deliver/QOH), NI (requested only), DI (requested only), C (description + requested only)
FR-03: Item Attributes — per type: Item, Description, Sell Price, Disc%, Disc$, QOH, Requested, Committed, Delivered, Outstanding (C shows '-')
FR-04: Quantity Logic — Outstanding = Requested - Delivered; over-commit/deliver auto-adjust Requested; Requested cannot go below Committed + Delivered
FR-05: Commit/Uncommit — Direct Commit when QOH >= Available; Quantity Input Screen when QOH < Available; over-commit adjusts Requested
FR-06: Deliver — Outstanding <= QOH: Delivered To only; Outstanding > QOH: quantity + Delivered To; committed first then QOH
FR-07: Delete — committed auto-returned to QOH; delivered requires Returned By prompt; line permanently removed
FR-08: Bulk Operations — Bulk Commit (FR-05 per item); Bulk Deliver (single Delivered To); failed items flagged individually
FR-09: Add Items — search (min 3 chars) or browse by category; default Requested=1; obsolete highlighting; alternate selection
FR-10: Replace Item — alternate search/select; original returned (committed auto, delivered prompts Returned By); new item Requested=1; merge if exists
FR-11: Special Order Creation — Quantity, Priority, Notes; SO linked to RO line; PR with Memo='RO-<Number>'; creation only
FR-12: Manage Quantities Screen — line-level; Commit/Uncommit and Deliver; pre-filled current committed value
FR-13: Move Items — select items; destination job; merge if same item exists; committed/delivered quantities follow
FR-14: Edit Items — field rules per RO Type and Job Type; discount lock/unlock for Regular; C items: Description and Requested only
out_of_scope: RO creation or Job creation workflows
